lines.t: (Start with a steady, rhythmic cadence—accentuate the end rhymes)
Darkness heavy, but I hear a whisper in the room
Thought I was forgotten, buried deep inside the gloom
Stuck looking backward, staring at the damage and the loss
Trapped in my own head, forgetting what You did upon the cross.
Then You cut through the noise—
Saying, "Daughter, get up, put your feet on the ground,
Look at Me, begin again, you’re no longer bound!"
Every chain of my shame, watch it shatter on the floor
I ain't living in the shadows of my past anymore!
So I fix my gaze on You, my Beloved
I close my ears to the accuser’s voice
My past is gone, washed away in Your love
As far as east from west, I make my choice
I leave the old behind, buried in the grave
You set me free, and Lord, I am saved!
Yesterday is dead and gone, tomorrow’s got no hold on me
Washed in the water, now I’m walking in the victory!
You told me, "Step back in line, put your hand in Mine,
We walking side-by-side, child, it’s your time to shine."
Learning how to reject the fake, choose what is good
Standing firm in the power where Your grace always stood.
No more enemy whispers trying to throw me off track
Got my armor strapped tight and I ain't looking back!
Chorus (Sung - Full Energy)
So I fix my gaze on You, my Beloved
I close my ears to the accuser’s voice
My past is gone, washed away in Your love
As far as east from west, I make my choice
I leave the old behind, buried in the grave
You set me free, and Lord, I am saved!
Heavy-laden, exhausted, carrying weight that wasn't mine
Trying to fight my own battles, running way out of line.
(Sung/Harmonized)
Then I took Your yoke, found Your heart was mild
Gentle, lowly, calling me Your child
My soul finds rest in who You are
My soul finds rest in who You are
Safe inside Your light, no longer far!
Your yoke is easy, Your burden is light
Walking with You straight into the morning light
Forgiven, restored, truly free…
Forever beginning again in Thee…
(Ad-lib fade) Yeah, forever beginning again… set free.
